problem_statement: Return a dictionary with keys "even" and "odd" mapping to the count of even and odd integers in values, respectively. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. Do not modify the input.
valid_input_domain: Return a dictionary with keys "even" and "odd" mapping to the count of even and odd integers in values, respectively. values is any Python list of integers (excluding bool), including an empty list. Do not modify the input.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution assigns 1 instead of incrementing for the odd count, so any list with odd numbers reports at most 1 odd.
